verdict.rationale: Isaac documents its own tooling for robotics foundation models. GR00T is an open reference platform with generalist models that can be post-trained for specific embodiments [48]. Supporting pieces cover teleop demonstration capture converted for GR00T post-training [60], RL post-training of GR00T in Isaac Lab via RLPT [57], portable policy deployment bundles for real hardware [58], and Isaac ROS packages for AI inference and policy integration [38, gh-6]. Community notes confirm GR00T N1 shipped under Apache 2; skepticism about demo speed is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit docs on wiring GR00T/VLA inference into a ROS 2 autonomy stack at runtime, independent hands-on reports of successful integration, and coverage beyond humanoid embodiments.
